problems: e27: axle-hole ↔ pin is not a compatible pair
notes: The minifigure (helmet, visor, head, torso, legs) on page 1 is not in the 26-piece parts list, so it is omitted.
The catalogue gives lego-43713 and lego-52501 only anti-studs, though the pictures show studs on top. Edges to or from these parts use null ports where the exact stud isn't in the catalogue.
Step 2: the picture is ambiguous about where the black 2x6 plate (b7) sits. I took it as joined to the underside of b1, with the two skids (b9, b10) on its studs in step 3.
Step 4: the blue round plates (b15, b16) sit on the skid ends, so I joined them to b9 and b10.
Step 5: the dark axle (b20) is the tail boom. It passes through the axle hole of b12 and into b19, and the tail pin (b21) goes in b19's pin hole. The tail rotor (b25) goes on b21.
Step 5: the main rotor (b24) is placed on the pin of the 2x2 tile (b18) at the top.
Step 6: the camera (b22) with its yellow round plate (b23) and the gun (b26) are attached to the body (b1) with null ports. The exact mounting spots are unclear in the pictures.
The hinge top plate (b14) is placed above the hinge base (b13). The 2x2 pin tile (b18) sits on b14.
